description: A curated gallery of real, hand-reviewed websites organised by color: browse nine color collections plus light and dark mode views, or enter a hex code such as #1D4ED8 to find the closest brand palettes. Every entry records the site's dominant color, full palette with hex codes, typography and a full-page screenshot, and industry filters can be combined with any color collection.
